requirement.statement: The .NET OM SHALL evaluate permission policies fail closed using graph witnesses and temporal entity-aware ABAC semantics observably equivalent to the Bun reference.

case.given: An allow policy declares a relation path but the subject has no matching edge sequence to the resource
case.then: The result SHALL deny and explanation SHALL record an unmatched path without a witness

case.given: An allow policy path has a directed subject-to-resource relation witness
case.then: The result SHALL allow and explanation SHALL contain the ordered canonical witness hops

case.given: A relation witness exists only at one valid-time point
case.when: Access is checked at current time and at the historical point
case.then: Each decision SHALL use the corresponding temporal graph state

case.given: Allow and deny policies have witnessed paths and subject/resource attributes with equality and ordered predicates
case.when: One predicate changes to match the deny policy
case.then: Deny SHALL override allow and explanation SHALL identify evaluated predicate results

case.given: An ABAC-referenced property changes over valid time
case.when: Access is checked with AsOf values on each side of the change
case.then: The result SHALL resolve the property at that same AsOf point

case.given: An allowed witnessed policy has a truthy field.<name> hide rule
case.then: The typed result and explanation SHALL mark that field hidden without changing the allow decision

case.given: A policy contains an unknown relation, unsupported ABAC operator or malformed reference
case.then: The policy SHALL not grant access and explanation SHALL expose deterministic failure detail

case.given: Equivalent policies and rules are seeded in different insertion orders
case.then: Decision, matched policy order, witness choice and explanation ordering SHALL remain deterministic
